arabic text: KATO NA MERA KHUSHQ GALA\nMEIN HUSSAIN HOON
english translation text: DON’T CUT MY DRY THROAT\nI AM HUSSAIN

arabic text: GUNJI BA WAQT-E-ASR SADA MEIN HUSSAIN HOON
english translation text: AT THE TIME OF ZUHR, THE SOUND CAME\nI AM HUSSAIN

arabic text: AMMA KISI NAY PAANI KI IK BOOND BHI NA DI\nMEIN BAAR BAAR KEHTA RAHA\nMEIN HUSSAIN HOON
english translation text: OH MOTHER NOBODY GAVE ME A DROP OF WATER\nI SAID OVER AND OVER AGAIN\nI AM HUSSAIN

arabic text: GUNJI BA WAQT-E-ASR SADA MEIN HUSSAIN HOON
english translation text: AT THE TIME OF ZUHR, THE SOUND CAME\nI AM HUSSAIN

arabic text: AEY SHAAMIO KAFAN NA - DIYA MUJHKO GHAM NAHIEN\nDAY DO MERI BEHEN KO RIDA\nMEIN HUSSAIN HOON
english translation text: OH PEOPLE OF SHAAM IF YOU DON’T GIVE ME KAFAN, I AM NOT GRIEVED\nBUT GIVE MY SISTER HER VEIL\nI AM HUSSAIN

arabic text: GUNJI BA WAQT-E-ASR SADA MEIN HUSSAIN HOON
english translation text: AT THE TIME OF ZUHR, THE SOUND CAME\nI AM HUSSAIN

arabic text: SUKHI HUEE HAIN SHIMR MERE - HALQ KI RAGAYN\nAAHISTA TU CHURI KO CHALA\nMEIN HUSSAIN HOON
english translation text: SHIMR, ALL THE VEINS IN MY THROAT ARE DRY\nSO CUT MY THROAT SLOWLY\nI AM HUSSAIN

arabic text: GUNJI BA WAQT-E-ASR SADA MEIN HUSSAIN HOON
english translation text: AT THE TIME OF ZUHR, THE SOUND CAME\nI AM HUSSAIN

arabic text: ZANU PAY RAKH KAY SAR KO KAHA IK ZAEEF NAY\nAKBAR KAHAN HAY RASTA BATA\nMEIN HUSSAIN HOON
english translation text: KEEPING HIS HEAD ON THE SHOULDER, AN OLD MAN CRIED\nSHOW ME THE WAY TO AKBAR\nI AM HUSSAIN

arabic text: GUNJI BA WAQT-E-ASR SADA MEIN HUSSAIN HOON
english translation text: AT THE TIME OF ZUHR, THE SOUND CAME\nI AM HUSSAIN

arabic text: DARBAR MEI LAEEN KAY KOHRAM MACH GAYA\nMUKHTAR SAY JO SAR NAY KAHA\nMEIN HUSSAIN HOON
english translation text: IN THE COURTYARD THERE WAS A BIG COMMOTION\nWHEN THE HEAD TOLD MUKHTAR:\nI AM HUSSAIN
